title: Sparse Koopman Autoencoders Identify Local Dynamical Regimes in Multibasin Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.29057v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Koopman autoencoders (KAEs) seek a higher-dimensional latent representation in which nonlinear dynamics evolve linearly. However, many interesting systems have multiple basins of attraction, and both theoretical and empirical work has shown these multibasin systems cannot generally admit a single finite-dimensional global Koopman embedding under standard assumptions. We posit that encoders with a sparsity-inducing objective encouraging few active latent coefficients will provide latent supports as an inspectable basin-modeling principle for Koopman autoencoders. We use these encoders producing sparse latents in training Sparse Koopman Autoencoders (SKAEs) without basin labels or other regime annotations, and treat the learned latent supports as model-produced regime variables after training. translated_title: 稀疏Koopman自编码器识别多盆地系统中的局部动力学机制
translated_abstract: Koopman自编码器（KAEs）寻求一种更高维的潜在表示，使非线性动力学在其中线性演化。然而，许多有趣的系统具有多个吸引盆地，理论和实证工作均已表明，在标准假设下，这些多盆地系统通常无法容纳单一的有限维全局Koopman嵌入。我们提出，采用稀疏性诱导目标（鼓励少量活跃潜在系数）的编码器将提供潜在支持集，作为Koopman自编码器的一种可检查的盆地建模原则。我们使用这些能产生稀疏潜在表示的编码器来训练稀疏Koopman自编码器（SKAEs），无需盆地标签或其他机制标注，并在训练后将学习到的潜在支持集视为模型产生的机制变量。在一系列程序生成的多盆地系统和混沌流上，我们展示了SKAEs相比……具有更优越的预测性能。
tldr: 提出稀疏Koopman自编码器（SKAE），通过稀疏性诱导目标在无需盆地标签的情况下自动识别多盆地系统的局部动力学机制，并在多盆地系统和混沌流上展现出优越的预测性能。
en_tdlr: Sparse Koopman Autoencoders (SKAEs) leverage sparsity-inducing objectives to automatically identify local dynamical regimes in multibasin systems without basin labels, achieving superior forecasting performance on multibasin systems and chaotic flows.
